content.title: JPMorgan's Tokenization Usage Encouraging: Maja Vujinovic
content.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s asset management arm is launching its first ever tokenized money market fund built on Ethereum, joining a growing list of Wall Street firms pushing into blockchain-based finance. On "Bloomberg Crypto", Maja Vujinovic, CEO of Digital Assets at FG Nexus, talks to Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec about the JPMorgan announcement, crypto prices and the year ahead for volatility.
